source: Owner dashboard delivery audits, 2026-10-07, 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 Europe/Amsterdam
note: Only fields present in the issue evidence are filled. Null means the audit summary did not provide that listing field; it is not an inferred listing value. Notify thresholds are inferred from which score counted as a miss. Each case carries an operator-confirmed expected outcome (should_alert); the gate counts correct outcomes, not raw scores. The 9 October bid case has no recorded audit score.

listing.title: Nintendo Switch OLED Wit met extra controllers en hoes

cases.diagnosis: The watched console is included; extra controllers and a case are useful bundle value, not an accessory-only listing.
cases.decision: Not a miss: listed at EUR 175 'bidding from' against an 'under EUR 200, only great matches' watch; the MW-58 bidding rule scores a starting bid near the maximum 7 or lower by design (price read from the public listing page, 7 Oct).

listing.title: GRATIS LAMINAAT 50M2 INCL ONDERVLOER (zelf eruit halen)

cases.diagnosis: Free means a real zero price; the laminate and underlay are useful even though collection requires removal. Brand is not stated.
cases.decision: Not a match (Daryl, 7 Oct): the watch asks for IKEA Prarie laminate; a free laminate of unknown brand is not that product. The audit was too generous.

cases.diagnosis: A comparable IKEA laminate model and useful quantity may fit, though the named line differs.
cases.decision: Not a match (Daryl, 7 Oct): Slätten is a different IKEA laminate model than the Prarie the watch asks for.
